text.content:
Trigger: Intimacy or sexual contact.

A ghoul who spends any length of time in the thrall of a @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce} domitor is likely encumbered with a variety of sexual dysfunctions. Female sufferers typically develop vaginismus (involuntary contraction of the vulval and rectal muscles preventing penetration) or dyspareunia (severe pain during intercourse); male sufferers, if not rendered completely impotent, sometimes fixate sexually on acts favored by their domitors. All such conditions tend to instill an extreme aversion to sex, further separating ghouls from the lives they led before their servitude.

Storytellers should consider whether including this derangement will make any players uncomfortable before allowing it; many people prefer not to explore such personal issues in detail during a game. The setting is a suitable venue for such unpleasantness, but players can be challenged without resorting to poor taste — this derangement can be played without dwelling on graphic details, extrapolating instead the likely effect such a condition has on a character's relationships.

vtmlarp.source: Clanbook: Tzimisce, Chapter Two: Ego and Evolution
